title: ABVC BioPharma, Inc. Announces Planned Spin-Off of BioKey (Cayman), Inc. Through Dividend Distribution of BioKey Shares to ABVC Shareholders
body: ABVC drops over 21% on July 9 after 9-day rally amid persistent going-concern warnings

questions.question: Is this the issuer's own cash, paper, or control — not a sector story?
